summary: The compliance review of the KYCFast: Video KYC and Biometric Onboarding product identified several gaps against the RBI rules. Key findings include: (1) IDFlow collects biometric data (fingerprints) without explicit consent for storage beyond onboarding purposes, violating need-based data collection requirements. (2) Full copies of bank statements and salary slips are stored indefinitely, exceeding the allowed minimal data retention. (3) No data retention or deletion policy is in place, with data kept indefinitely. (4) The product does not specify whether only minimal data is stored, which is a requirement under RBI guidelines. (5) The product does not provide borrowers with options to consent, restrict disclosure, manage data retention, revoke consent, or delete data, which is a critical compliance requirement.
